agent_note: Prose fiction, first-person present-tense contemporary narration. 15 event quotes: 11 present / 4 past (73.3% present). The past minority is not noise -- q01300, q01304, q01308 are first-person recollection/backstory, and q01294 is a distinct THIRD-PERSON past strand referring to reading back 'the entry', suggesting an embedded diary or a separately narrated past section. So the split has a structural explanation on both counts (recollection strand plus a third-person past strand), not uncertainty. Very high gnomic share (6/22) -- this book's quote page is heavily aphorism-selected, exactly the source bias METHODOLOGY warns about; a two-bucket filter would have counted five of those six as present-tense evidence.
